_readme: SINGLE source of per-user personalization. Copy to profile.json and edit (or run `python setup.py`). After any change, regenerate derived configs with `python profile_lib.py --regen` (the wizard and the dashboard /setup page do this automatically). Fields marked (advanced) can be left as-is by non-technical users.

identity._note: resume_prefix names every tailored output file, e.g. Jane_Doe_Resume_Acme_DataAnalyst.docx (no spaces). real_titles/past_companies fill the summary-rule guardrails so tailoring never invents a title you never held or mirrors the job posting.

resume._note: Folder (relative to the project, or an absolute path) holding your base resume(s) + optional STAR-stories source. Any .docx/.pdf filename is accepted.

skills._note: Your REAL, claimable skills. Drives the job-match score and the never-invent rule (the pipeline flags posting tools NOT in this list rather than fabricating them). Regenerating writes config/skills.json and a generic starter config/skill_aliases.json (common synonyms only) — hand-tune the alias map afterward for best matching.

search.titles_note: Plain role keywords. The generators build the boolean query for each board. Multi-word phrases are auto-quoted.
search.exclude_note: Titles to filter OUT (added as NOT (...) on both boards).

location._note: Only `query` is user-entered; the wizard / dashboard geocodes it to fill city/state/country/lat/lon/formatted_address (hiringcafe.com needs coordinates). Edit `query` and re-geocode rather than hand-editing coordinates.

search.workplace_types_note: Any of: Remote, Hybrid, Onsite, Field. 'Field' is hiringcafe.com-only (ignored on LinkedIn).
search.include_remote_note: When true and Remote is selected, also pulls country-wide remote roles (hiringcafe.com adds a country location; LinkedIn widens via the country in the location string).
search.seniority_note: Any of: Internship, Entry Level, Mid Level, Senior Level, Director, Executive. Mapped to LinkedIn f_E buckets and hiringcafe.com seniorityLevel.
search.years_experience_note: [min, max] years. hiringcafe.com roleYoeRange only (LinkedIn has no YoE filter — approximated by seniority).
search.employment_types_note: Any of: Full Time, Part Time, Contract, Temporary, Internship. Mapped to LinkedIn f_JT and hiringcafe.com commitmentTypes.
search.salary_note: hiringcafe.com uses exact min/max. LinkedIn only supports a coarse min bucket (rounded down to the nearest $20k step from $40k).
search.advanced_filters_note: (advanced) hiringcafe.com-only. Leave defaults unless you know you want otherwise.
search.date_presets_note: Days-back for the 24h (fresh) and 7d (weekly) scrape passes. Drives hiringcafe.com dateFetchedPastNDays and LinkedIn f_TPR.
search.sources_note: Toggle which boards to generate URLs for. linkedin_top_applicant adds LinkedIn's Top-Applicant collection feed — a UI-only Premium page: it renders only in a browser already signed in to LinkedIn Premium, and no API/OAuth path exists for the app to authenticate to it.

notify._note: Free phone push via ntfy.sh — pick a long random topic and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Anyone who knows the topic can read it, so keep it secret-ish.

git.name: Jane Doe
git._note: Identity for the daily auto-commit. remote is optional (leave blank to skip pushing).
